title: InfoGeometry: A Lean 4 Formalization of Noncommutative Information Geometry, Peirce-Weyl Operator Algebras, and Inductive Colimits

creators.name: Goutev, Nikolay
creators.affiliation: Institute for Nuclear Research and Nuclear Energy (INRNE-BAS), Bulgarian Academy of Sciences

creators.name: Tonev, Dimitar
creators.affiliation: Institute for Nuclear Research and Nuclear Energy (INRNE-BAS), Bulgarian Academy of Sciences

description: Lean 4 (v4.34.1 / Mathlib) formalization of noncommutative information geometry, division-free Peirce-Weyl units, Drazin and Moore-Penrose spectral splittings, Jordan-Lie operator multiplication closure, weighted KMS trace identities, Grassmannian Ehresmann gauge connections, and categorical UHF inductive colimits over involutive rings.
